source_contract.domain_selection: select source_nodes whose frozen domain identity is Domain III, preserving exact source order and identity

batching.rule: No frozen source node may be omitted, duplicated, renamed, reordered, or migrated. Candidate topology remains Learning-owner provisional unless stronger source or human authority is separately observed.

candidate_requirements.subskills: Each candidate requirement receives a bounded assessable capability statement, exact frozen parent binding, Learning-owner provisional derivation class, evidence references and matching decomposition edge.
candidate_requirements.prerequisite_edges: Do not infer hard dependencies from source order or topic proximity. Admit a hard edge only with explicit source-bound or Learning-owner semantic rationale sufficient under the existing topology contract; otherwise preserve it as UNRESOLVED__NOT_CANONICAL.
candidate_requirements.acyclicity: Every cumulative candidate must remain acyclic and endpoint-resolvable under Validator 003.

successor_instruction: Materialize the exact first five frozen Domain III source-order requirements III.A.1, III.B.1, III.B.2, III.C.1 and III.D.1; add only evidence-bound provisional subskills/decomposition and justified prerequisites; preserve uncertain dependencies as UNRESOLVED__NOT_CANONICAL; validate cumulatively against completed Domain I and Domain II structure using unchanged Validator 003; preserve exact hosted evidence; then continue Domain III batch 02 rather than stopping.
stop_condition: All 13 frozen Domain III requirements have truthful source-order bounded dispositions across three validated batches, all admitted edges remain resolvable and acyclic, uncertainty remains explicit, human/SME/certification fields remain UNOBSERVED, and the next Domain IV or cross-domain closure successor can be selected without replaying Domains I-III.
